editorNotes.purpose: Original short written-response prompt bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Ten Explore short-text responses and ten Extend paragraph responses. Rubrics allow defensible answers rather than requiring exact wording. Requires editorial and pedagogical review before approval or publication.
